function concrete(value: object) {
  if (typeof value === "function") return value();
}
function boxed(value: Object) {
  if (typeof value === "function") return value.apply(undefined, []);
}
function unconstrained<T>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "function") return value();
}
function empty<T extends {}>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "function") return value();
}
function callable<T extends () => number>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "function") return value();
}
function union<T extends object | null>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "function") return value();
}
function mixed<T extends { count: number } | (() => number)>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value === "function") return value();
}
function nonCallable<T extends object>(value: T) {
  if (typeof value !== "function") return value.toString();
}
console.log(concrete(() => 1), boxed(() => 2), unconstrained(() => 3), empty(() => 4));
console.log(callable(() => 5), union(() => 6), union(null), mixed(() => 7), nonCallable({}));
